milestone.title: raul Autopilot lane — live status graph + multi-milestone queue rendering (manual refresh only)

intent.outcome: The Autopilot lane renders a live status graph (per-pane: pane ID, role, last notify, last verifier verdict, cycle count) and a multi-milestone queue view when the active session has more than one milestone; manual `r` refreshes against `mp autopilot session show` and `mp autopilot-control status`.

problem.description: Once a session is running, the raul user needs visibility into what is happening in each pane of the herdr workspace — without leaving the raul window to inspect herdr panes directly. The status graph subscribes (via manual refresh) to the session.json + control-plane state and renders it. Cycle-flow events (C3: WaitingRunner → Reviewing → Deciding, etc.) drive which fields are highlighted. The multi-milestone queue view handles the locked decision that autopilot supports single-milestone OR queue mode (the same pane-set reused across milestones).

in_scope: Status graph and ordered multi-milestone queue sourced only from mp autopilot session/status/reviews APIs.
Per-milestone cycle, findings, AC evidence, history, telemetry, and next-action detail views.
Pause, resume, cancel, and targeted steer controls submitted through mp autopilot control commands.
out_of_scope: Automatic refresh scheduling, owned by M217.
Picker and override editing, owned by M215.
Cycle execution and liveness, owned by the headless M213 engine.

acceptance_criteria.description: Status graph renders per-pane rows with all five fields (label, pane ID, role skill, last notify, last verdict) in golden-file tests; formatting matches the lane's existing text/cursor conventions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_status_graph --no-fail-fast exit 0 (7/7 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Multi-milestone queue view renders when session has > 1 milestone; the active milestone is highlighted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_queue_view --no-fail-fast exit 0 (8/8 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: `r` re-reads `mp autopilot session show <id>` and `mp autopilot status <id>` through adapters; no legacy autopilot-control command or direct plan-file read remains.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_manual_refresh --no-fail-fast exit 0 (9/9 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: When C2's verifier emits a typed `Violation`, the offending pane row shows a 'role violation' badge; click-to-expand reveals violation name + evidence hint. Golden-file tests cover each violation variant.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_violation_badge --no-fail-fast exit 0 (10/10 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: The detail panel consumes session show/events, reviews finding list, and M213 next-action APIs. It never reads activity.json or session files directly. Golden fixtures cover cycles, findings, history, drift, and cap fields.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_detail_panel --no-fail-fast exit 0 (11/11 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Pause stops new dispatch at the next boundary and Resume continues the same session; Cancel is terminal after confirmation and remains replayable; restarting after Cancel creates a new session from an explicitly selected queue; Steer sends a targeted one-off message through `mp autopilot control steer`.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_recovery_controls --no-fail-fast exit 0 (10/10 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-AC visualization: in the per-milestone detail view, below the cycle-flow timeline, render an `ACs (passed / total)` row-by-row breakdown sourced from session.json `queue[i].ac_pass_fail`. Each row shows AC id + description (truncated) + status (passed / failed / pending) + the stamped evidence string. Failed ACs are visually distinct (red marker); pending ACs are neutral. The list scrolls if it overflows the panel. Golden-file tests cover the three status paths and overflow scrolling.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_ac_detail --no-fail-fast exit 0 (11/11 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Active-session telemetry aggregates: in the detail view, alongside `drifted` (time-since-last-state-change for the active stage), render cross-milestone aggregates — total time-in-active-stage across all three panes, attempts-per-stage (how many times each cycle stage has been entered across the queue), per-AC pass/fail counts across milestones. Aggregates are computed from session.json state on each refresh; they reset on session start. Golden-file tests cover a synthetic session with one shipped milestone + one in-flight + one pending milestone.

design_decisions.choice: Manual `r` calls both `mp autopilot session show <id>` (for queued milestones + persisted overrides) and `mp autopilot-control status` (for live pane state).
design_decisions.rationale: Two sources cover both persistent and live state, matching the dual-source pattern in M179 S4 (`mp watch --dry-run` + M178 status).

design_decisions.choice: Badge + click-to-expand rather than always showing detail.
design_decisions.rationale: Detail is verbose; the badge highlights the lane needs attention without crowding the at-a-glance view.

steps.action: Per-AC visualization row set in the detail view. Reuses M216 AC-05's existing panel; adds an `ACs` section below the cycle-flow timeline. Reads `queue[i].ac_pass_fail` from session.json (refetched on `r`/auto-refresh). Each row: `AC-XX  desc-trunc-40  [passed|failed|pending]  evidence-trunc-60`. Failed ACs render with a red marker; pending with neutral. Fits cleanly into the existing detail-panel scroll viewport.
steps.done_when: AC-07 evidence is stamped via `mp milestone criterion pass 216 AC-07 --evidence`.

steps.action: Implement active-session telemetry computation in `crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot.rs`. Aggregates pull from session.json at refresh tick: (a) time-in-active-stage = sum of (now - last_state_change_at) for each pane in Working/Reviewing/Deciding; (b) attempts-per-stage = count of cycle-flow transitions per Dispatching/WaitingRunner/Reviewing/Deciding/AwaitingUser state across the queue; (c) per-AC pass/fail counts = sum of status from queue[*].ac_pass_fail. Render as a labeled key-value block in the detail panel above the cycle-flow timeline.
steps.done_when: AC-08 evidence is stamped via `mp milestone criterion pass 216 AC-08 --evidence`.
